university.name: University of Leicester
university.summary: University in Leicester, England, offering undergraduate, postgraduate taught and research degrees to international students. Most taught Master's courses last one year, and several also admit in January. The university publishes Pakistan-specific entry guidance and has a named recruitment contact for Pakistan.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor, Student route, rated Student Sponsor (Track Record) (gov.uk register dated 2026-10-07)

courses.title: Advanced Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 12 to 16 months full time (MSc); 24 to 28 months with industry placement
courses.overview: Taught Master's in computer science for graduates with a substantial computing background, combining a core module each semester with optional modules and an individual project. An industry placement version and PGDip and PGCert exit awards are also offered.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:1 degree (or equivalent) in a relevant subject with a substantial element of Computing. Relevant work experience may also be considered.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 or equivalent (Leicester equivalency table: minimum 5.5 in each IELTS component; PTE 59; TOEFL iBT 80; Duolingo 105)
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: honours BSc or BEng with a minimum GPA of 2.7/4.0 for Computing or Engineering Master's. A four-year bachelor's with a Medium of Instruction letter from listed Pakistani universities may be considered for English, case by case.
courses.career_notes: Some modules are delivered with industry colleagues and the school has an Industrial Advisory Board; placement routes add work experience.
courses.application_deadline_note: January 2027 start: apply by 20 November 2026. September 2027 dates not yet published (for September 2026, visa applicants had to apply by 24 July 2026).
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published; fee shown is for September 2026 starters. Page also shows PGDip GBP 19,400 and PGCert GBP 9,700. An extra fee applies if a placement is secured.

courses.title: Finance
courses.overview: One-year taught Master's in finance at the School of Business, built around core finance modules taught over two semesters and a dissertation in the third semester. The course is linked to the CFA Program syllabus.
highlights: Covers over 70% of the CFA Candidate Body of Knowledge
courses.academic_requirements: A good second class honours degree or equivalent from a recognised university.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 or equivalent (Leicester equivalency table: minimum 5.5 in each IELTS component; PTE 61; TOEFL iBT 90; Duolingo 120)
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: four-year honours BA or BBA with a minimum GPA of 2.5/4.0 for Master's entry. A four-year bachelor's with a Medium of Instruction letter from listed Pakistani universities may be considered for English, case by case.
courses.career_notes: Recognised as a CFA Programme Partner Institution.
courses.application_deadline_note: September 2027 dates not yet published (for September 2026, visa applicants had to apply by 24 July 2026).
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published; fee shown is for September 2026 starters. Page says 'good second class honours degree' without stating 2:1 or 2:2, so uk_min_degree_class is left null. Core module names are not listed on the page.

courses.title: International Commercial Law
courses.overview: Specialist stream of the Leicester LLM. Students take eight optional modules, at least six from the International Commercial Law lists, and the degree certificate names the specialism.
highlights: Intellectual Property Law for International Business
courses.academic_requirements: A good second class degree or an equivalent degree in an appropriate discipline.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 or equivalent (Leicester equivalency table: minimum 5.5 in each IELTS component; PTE 61; TOEFL iBT 90; Duolingo 120)
courses.experience_requirements: Relevant post-graduation experience is given due credit.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: four-year honours BA or BBA with a minimum GPA of 2.5/4.0 for Master's entry. The page does not name LLB holders specifically.
courses.career_notes: The Law School holds an annual Law Fair with law firms and graduate employers.
courses.application_deadline_note: September 2027 dates not yet published (for September 2026, visa applicants had to apply by 24 July 2026).
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published; fee shown is for September 2026 entry. Degree class wording 'good second class' does not state 2:1 or 2:2. On 2026-10-10 the page said its online application system was currently unavailable. A 2027 page URL exists but could not be opened.

courses.title: Advanced Mechanical Engineering
courses.duration_text: 12 to 16 months full time; 24 to 28 months with industry placement
courses.overview: Taught Master's for mechanical engineering graduates combining core and optional engineering modules with an individual project. A version with a 9 to 11 month industry placement is available, and there are January and September starts.
highlights: Optional 9 to 11 month industry placement, normally paid
courses.academic_requirements: Good second class honours degree (or equivalent) in a relevant subject such as Mechanical Engineering.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 or equivalent (Leicester equivalency table: minimum 5.5 in each IELTS component; PTE 59; TOEFL iBT 80; Duolingo 105)
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: honours BSc or BEng with a minimum GPA of 2.7/4.0 for Computing or Engineering Master's. A four-year bachelor's with a Medium of Instruction letter from listed Pakistani universities may be considered for English, case by case.
courses.career_notes: Course page states accreditation by the IET and IMechE.
courses.application_deadline_note: January 2027 start: apply by 20 November 2026, deposit by 27 November 2026. September 2027 dates not yet published.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published; fee shown is for September 2026 starters. Degree class wording 'good second class' does not state 2:1 or 2:2. Core module names did not appear on the page. An extra fee applies if a placement is secured.

courses.title: Pharmacy
courses.overview: Four-year integrated Master's in pharmacy (UCAS B230) organised around curriculum themes running through all years, including pharmacology, therapeutics and prescribing, and pharmaceutics. Selection includes an online interview.
courses.academic_requirements: A-levels: ABB, including Biology or Chemistry plus one other science, from Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Maths or Psychology. IB: Diploma with 30 points, HL 6, 6, 5 including Biology or Chemistry and one other listed science. Other national and international qualifications considered.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 7.0 (or equivalent) (Leicester equivalency table: minimum 5.5 in each IELTS component; PTE 68; TOEFL iBT 100; Duolingo 130)
courses.experience_requirements: Online interview at selection stage. Offers are subject to a Certificate of Good Standing or Good Conduct Letter no more than 6 months old before the course starts.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page lists A-levels or IB for direct first year entry; it gives no Intermediate (HSSC) route into this course.
courses.career_notes: Course page states provisional accreditation by the General Pharmaceutical Council, with full accreditation being sought. Graduates complete foundation training and a registration assessment before GPhC registration; international students doing this in the UK need a Graduate route visa.
courses.application_deadline_note: Apply through UCAS; the course page refers applicants to UCAS for deadlines.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published; fee shown is for 2026 starters. The 2027 entry page could not be opened. Accreditation is provisional.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years full time (G400); 4 years with Year Abroad (G401) or Year in Industry (G402)
courses.overview: Three-year undergraduate degree in computer science (UCAS G400) covering programming, mathematics and computer systems, with a second-year group project for an external client. Year Abroad and Year in Industry versions are available.
courses.academic_requirements: A/AS-levels: ABB (or BBB plus EPQ at grade B). IB: Diploma with 30 points, with Maths conditions if GCSE Maths grade 5/B is not held.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 or equivalent (Leicester equivalency table: minimum 5.5 in each IELTS component; PTE 59; TOEFL iBT 80; Duolingo 105)
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page lists A-levels or IB for direct first year entry; completion of first year at a Pakistani university in relevant subjects may be considered. A Foundation Year version (UCAS G991) exists for applicants below direct entry.
courses.career_notes: Course page states BCS accreditation toward Chartered IT Professional registration and partial fulfilment toward Chartered Engineer.
courses.application_deadline_note: Apply through UCAS; no deadline stated on the course page.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published; fee shown is for 2026 starters. The 2027 entry page could not be opened.

courses.title: Law
courses.duration_text: 3 years full time; 4 years with Year Abroad
courses.overview: Three-year qualifying law degree (UCAS M100). The first year introduces the English legal system, court structure, the development of law and statutory interpretation, and the course includes 100 hours of work-related learning.
highlights: Court structure and the development of law
courses.academic_requirements: A-levels: AAB. General Studies accepted. IB: Diploma with 33 points, including grade 4 in English A or 5 in English B if GCSE English Language grade C/4 is not held.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, with 6.0 in writing (or equivalent) (Leicester equivalency table: PTE 61; TOEFL iBT 90; Duolingo 120)
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page lists A-levels or IB for direct first year entry; completion of first year at a Pakistani university in relevant subjects may be considered. A Social Sciences, Arts and Humanities Foundation Year is mentioned on the course page.
courses.career_notes: Meets the academic requirements for training as a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published; fee shown is for 2026 starters. min_ielts_band left null because writing requires 6.0 while other components follow the general 5.5 minimum. The undated course URL showed an older fee (GBP 18,950), so the 2026 page was used.

courses.title: Business and Management
courses.duration_text: 3 years full time; 4 years with Year Abroad or Year in Industry
courses.overview: Three-year business and management degree (UCAS N200) with a first year shared with the Marketing and Human Resource Management degrees, allowing a switch after Year 1. It includes 100 hours of work-related learning and an optional Year in Industry.
courses.academic_requirements: A/AS-levels: ABB. All subjects accepted. IB: Diploma with 30 points overall, plus Maths and English conditions if GCSE grade 4/C is not held.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 or equivalent (Leicester equivalency table: minimum 5.5 in each IELTS component; PTE 61; TOEFL iBT 90; Duolingo 120)
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page lists A-levels or IB for direct first year entry; completion of first year at a Pakistani university in relevant subjects may be considered.
courses.career_notes: Prepares graduates for roles in management, consultancy, marketing and entrepreneurship.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: the 2027 entry page states 2027/28 international fees are yet to be confirmed and gives GBP 20,200 per year as the 2026/27 figure.

courses.title: Engineering with Foundation Year (Integrated STEM Foundation Year)
courses.duration_text: 4 years full time including foundation year; 5 years with Year Abroad or Year in Industry
courses.overview: University-run foundation year (UCAS H991) leading to Year 1 of any Leicester BEng or MEng engineering degree on successful completion. The foundation year covers mathematics, mechanics, materials and engineering practice.
courses.academic_requirements: A-levels: BCC or points equivalent from best three A-levels, including Maths or Physics. IB: Diploma with 26 points including appropriate maths and science content. Other international qualifications considered.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 or equivalent (Leicester equivalency table: minimum 5.5 in each IELTS component; PTE 59; TOEFL iBT 80; Duolingo 105)
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page (STEM International Foundation Year): HSC with a minimum of grade C overall, plus grade A (85% or above) in Maths and a Science; the science depends on the pathway.
courses.career_notes: Completion gives automatic progression to Year 1 of any Leicester BEng or MEng Engineering course.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published. GBP 20,750 is the foundation year fee for 2026 starters; later years for 2026 starters are GBP 25,100 per year. Foundation courses are excluded from the undergraduate merit scholarship and fee waiver. pk_min_percent left null because the 85% applies to Maths and a Science, not overall.

scholarships.name: International Postgraduate Taught Merit Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 tuition fee discount, for a maximum of one year
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition discount for international fee-paying students on full-time, campus-based Master's or PGCE courses who hold a qualification equivalent to a UK first class degree.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; qualification equivalent to a UK first class degree; full-time campus Master's or PGCE. Not open to applicants domiciled in India or Thailand.
scholarships.deadline_note: No separate application; considered automatically with the course application.
scholarships.notes: Page covers September 2026, January 2027 and April 2027 intakes; September 2027 not yet listed. Only one University of Leicester scholarship can be held.

scholarships.name: Global Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Competitive tuition discount for international students with a first class degree or equivalent starting a full-time, campus-based Master's. Applicants submit a short video answering three set questions after receiving an offer.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; first class degree or equivalent; offer for a full-time campus Master's (not PGCE, PGCert or PGDip). Not open to students from or domiciled in India.
scholarships.deadline_note: January and April 2027 intakes: deadline 6 November 2026, winners announced 25 November 2026. April applies only to College of Business PGT courses.
scholarships.notes: Cannot be combined with other university scholarships or discounts unless stated. September 2026 round closed; September 2027 terms not yet published.

scholarships.name: ULSB International Dean's Scholarship
scholarships.provider_name: University of Leicester School of Business
scholarships.value_text: GBP 8,000 tuition fee discount; up to 10 awards a year (5 undergraduate, 5 postgraduate)
scholarships.summary: Competitive School of Business tuition discount for overseas fee-paying students from eight named countries, including Pakistan, on full-time School of Business programmes. Offer holders are invited to complete a scholarship application form.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee status; national of Pakistan, Thailand, Nigeria, Vietnam, Kenya, Bangladesh, Cambodia or Saudi Arabia; minimum 3.3 GPA or equivalent (undergraduate) or 2:1 or equivalent (postgraduate); full-time School of Business programme.
scholarships.deadline_note: Rolling applications; selections finalised by early August for September entry.
scholarships.notes: Published terms refer to programmes commencing September 2026; 2027 terms not yet published. Page does not say whether the GBP 8,000 is per year or total, so value_basis is null. The 3.3 GPA scale is not stated. Subject to annual review.

scholarships.name: International Undergraduate Merit Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 tuition fee discount per year
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition discount for international fee-paying undergraduates who achieve results above the standard entry requirement. Leicester foundation and Year One students progressing with an overall score of 70% or above are also considered.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; full-time campus undergraduate degree; grades equivalent to two above the standard A-level requirement (for example AAA where ABB is required). Excludes Medicine, LLB Maitrise, STEM International Foundation and International Year 1 courses.
scholarships.notes: International scholarships page lists it for 2026/27; the separate detail page still shows September 2025 terms (maximum three years). 2027 terms not yet published. Only one University of Leicester scholarship can be held.

scholarships.name: International Undergraduate Tuition Fee Waiver
scholarships.value_text: Full tuition fee waiver for up to three years; 30 awards for September 2026 within 150 planned over five years
scholarships.summary: Competitive full tuition waiver for international fee-paying undergraduates on courses of up to three years. Applicants submit a short video answering three set questions; living and accommodation costs are not covered.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; grades equivalent to two above the standard A-level requirement; full-time UK campus course. Excludes Medicine, LLB Maitrise, STEM and Biological Sciences International Foundation, International Year 1, and programmes longer than three years. Leicester must be the firm choice.
scholarships.deadline_note: September 2026 round opened 18 November 2025 and closed 30 June 2026. 2027 round dates not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Page describes a five-year scheme but only September 2026 terms are published. Cannot be combined with other university scholarships or discounts unless stated.

scholarships.name: Chancellor's International Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 tuition fee discount per year
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition discount for international fee-paying students who meet the entry requirements of their course, with undergraduate and postgraduate taught versions. Recipients are notified with their offer.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; meet course entry requirements. Excludes Medicine and LLB Maitrise at undergraduate level. Not available to applicants domiciled in India.
scholarships.notes: Listed on the international scholarships page; the postgraduate detail page still shows September 2025 to April 2026 intakes and a one-year maximum, and the postgraduate list marks it for January 2026 courses. 2027 terms not yet published. Only one University of Leicester scholarship can be held.

scholarships.name: Alumni Discount
scholarships.summary: Automatic fee discount for self-financing Leicester graduates and former Study Abroad or Erasmus students progressing to a higher-level taught or research degree, campus or distance learning.
scholarships.criteria_text: Completed a Leicester undergraduate degree or PGCE, Study Abroad or Erasmus placement, or Leicester Master's, and progressing to a higher-level degree. Excludes PGCE and four-year undergraduate Master's.
scholarships.notes: Page states no intake restriction. Cannot be combined with other payment schemes or with the Family Loyalty discount for international students. Relevant mainly to existing Leicester students.

scholarships.name: Family Loyalty Discount
scholarships.value_text: 10% discount on tuition fees for each year of the course
scholarships.summary: Tuition discount for international fee-paying students on full-time courses whose sibling, spouse or parent is studying on, or has graduated from, a full-time Leicester course.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; full-time course; sibling, spouse or parent currently studying on, or graduated from, a full-time Leicester course.
scholarships.notes: Application route not stated on the pages opened; set to separate_application pending confirmation. Detail terms page not opened.
